title: refine-story project configuration
description: Per-project configuration for the refine-story skill. Place as .refine-story.json at the project root.

$schema.description: Optional pointer to this schema for editor autocomplete.

tracker.description: Which issue tracker Step 6 writes to.

scale.description: Fibonacci point scale used for relative estimation.

splitThreshold.description: Stories estimated at or above this value must be split before entering a sprint.

goldenStory.description: The Golden Story (Clean Agile): a real completed story the team agrees is a solid medium (3 points). It has a dual role — the relative-estimation anchor AND the style exemplar the refined story is written to match. Its body is copied into config so both sizing and rendering use a saved snapshot without re-fetching from the tracker.

ref.description: Tracker id of the anchor story (e.g. #5 or PROJ-5). Used by the update-golden-story skill to refresh the saved copy.

body.description: The full story content copied from the tracker (description + acceptance criteria). The saved snapshot used for sizing comparisons and as the style exemplar the output mirrors.

project.description: GitHub Projects (v2) field ids for Status + Estimate automation. Omit to skip.

siteUrl.description: Used to resolve cloudId if cloudId is not set.

storyPointsFieldId.description: Custom field id for Story Points, e.g. customfield_10016.

teamKey.description: Team key the story lives in, e.g. ENG (the prefix in issue ids like ENG-123).

projectName.description: Optional Linear project to attach the issue to.

featureLabel.description: Optional label applied to user-facing stories.

taskLabel.description: Optional label applied to infra/tooling stories.

readyStateName.description: Workflow state to move the issue to when refinement is done.
